candidates.title: Studio Loop Executable Parity Pack
candidates.why: The current repo can start and play, but the newer `/audit` and `/implement` skill contracts point at helpers that are absent locally: `sample-codebase`, `audit-sidecar`, `render-audit-md`, `session-floor`, `cache-genius-list`, and `record-skill-cost`. That makes every future unattended Studio OS loop depend on agent memory instead of executable project truth.
candidates.recipe: Add lightweight repo-local compatibility helpers for the missing scripts, route `node scripts/ops.mjs genius-list` through the cache, and keep the outputs public-safe: source sampling only reports paths/line counts/previews, audit rendering consumes the existing `candidates` shape, session-floor returns a deterministic CONTINUE/STOP code, and cost records store context-meter snapshots without secrets.

L1.recipe: Add `ops.mjs genius-list` plus `cache-genius-list.mjs` so the startup brief command stops failing.

L2.recipe: Add all missing helper shims: `sample-codebase.mjs`, `scripts/lib/audit-sidecar.mjs`, `render-audit-md.mjs`, `session-floor.mjs`, `cache-genius-list.mjs`, and `record-skill-cost.mjs`; wire `ops.mjs genius-list` to the cache helper.

L3.recipe: Also add smoke coverage for each helper and have closeout consume the generated cost ledger in its status board.

candidates.title: Complete Nemesis Counter Map
candidates.why: Session 87 shipped a nemesis dossier, but live code verifies the counter-weapon map is inline and misses several actual boss guidance types: Karen, Landlord, Splitter, Algorithm, and Developer all fall back to generic advice. candidates.recipe: Move nemesis weapon recommendations into `waveDirector.js` beside `BOSS_GUIDANCE`, export `getNemesisWeaponRecommendation()`, cover every concrete boss guidance key, wire `App.jsx` to use it, and add focused tests for completeness plus unknown fallback.

L1.recipe: Patch the inline map in `App.jsx` to include all currently known boss types.

L2.recipe: Export a tested helper from `waveDirector.js` and replace the inline `App.jsx` map.

L3.recipe: Use the helper to also render a pre-run boss dossier preview when a rivalry seed includes a boss-wave death.

candidates.title: Protocol Drift Checks Cover Next-Command Helpers
candidates.why: `npm run protocol:drift` can report clean while the next command in the official loop still fails. That is an observability-honesty issue: green protocol status must cover the scripts the current `/start → /audit → /implement → /closeout` path advertises.
candidates.recipe: Extend `scripts/protocol-drift-check.mjs` required/optional helper coverage to include the newly executable audit/implement/closeout helpers and the genius-list cache path; verify JSON mode reports `status=ok` after the parity pack lands.

L1.recipe: Add only `scripts/cache-genius-list.mjs` and `scripts/record-skill-cost.mjs` to optional drift checks.

L2.recipe: Add the full next-command helper set to protocol drift coverage with clear purposes.

L3.recipe: Have drift check run each helper in dry-run mode and report contract failures, not just file presence.
